messages:
jamie (partnerships): Quick heads-up — SkyScale asked us to co-run a joint webinar on Apr 28, 11:00am PT. They want 30–40m of content + 15m live demo + 10m Q&A. Need to lock speakers, demo plan, and swag buckets by Apr 18. Can we coordinate here?

lee (events): Dates work for our calendar. Venue: virtual (Zoom webinar). Is partner expecting co-branded landing page + registration?

jamie (partnerships): Yes — partner asked for a shared landing page and 2 co-led talks. We control slides and the run-of-show. They want a hardware mention (SkyScale Edge) in the demo.

anika (marketing): Swag ask from partner: 200 stickers, 75 t-shirts (mixed sizes), 50 mini demo dongles. Budget ok if partner splits shipping. Can we confirm shipping addresses and customs?

sanjay (solutions): For the live demo we need: provider API keys, a sample tenant (no PII), and a fallback recorded demo if live environment flaps. Also want to avoid cross-tenant data—partner to provide isolated demo account.

kevin (eng-runtime): I can produce a headless fallback clip and a tiny self-contained demo repo. Plan: run live container against SkyScale staging; if latency > 600ms for 10s, switch to recorded clip and hand control to slides. I'll write a 1-page runbook and a health-check script.

jamie (partnerships): Draft run-of-show (opinions welcome):

    11:00 — intro + agenda (5m) — Jamie + Maria
    11:05 — Redwood product overview (10m) — Kevin
    11:15 — SkyScale architecture + integration (10m) — Maria
    11:25 — Live demo (15m) — Kevin + SkyScale engineer
    11:40 — Customer stories / quick notes (5m) — Sanjay
    11:45 — Q&A + close (15m)

jamie (partnerships): Action items:
  - Maria (SkyScale): confirm demo account + staging endpoint by Apr 10
  - Kevin: produce recorded fallback clip + runbook by Apr 15
  - Anika: finalize swag SKU list + ship plan by Apr 12
  - Lee: schedule rehearsal + produce calendar invite by Apr 20
  - Sanjay: prepare a 3-slide integration summary by Apr 18

anika (marketing): Will also need partner logo (SVG) and approved co-branding guidelines. Can someone add the logo to this thread? Also prefer courier: DHL or FedEx preferred for EU.

maria (SkyScale): Confirmed — sending staging creds to jamie via secure DM today. Logo and co-branding pdf attached to partner drive: https://drive.skyscale.example/sdks/webinar-brand.zip

maria (SkyScale): We can cover 50% of swag shipping costs. Ops contact for shipping: ops@skyscale.com (Lina). Customs paperwork handled on our side for EU shipments.

kevin (eng-runtime): Quick snippet for the health-check we'll run before going live:

    curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}\n" https://staging.api.skyscale.example/health || echo "fallback"

kevin (eng-runtime): If time_total > 0.6 then we'll flip to fallback. I'll put this in the rehearsal checklist.

lee (events): Rehearsals — propose two slots: Apr 22 10am PT (tech run) and Apr 25 11am PT (full dress). We'll need 30–45m each. I will create calendar invites after we lock speakers.

jamie (partnerships): Speakers so far: Jamie, Kevin (Redwood), Maria + Rahul (SkyScale eng). Please confirm final speaker list by Apr 12. Also any legal copy for the landing page (partner blurbs) due Apr 14.

anika (marketing): Swag plan: 200 stickers, 75 shirts (S/M/L/XL split 30/25/15/5), 50 USB demo dongles. We'll split SKU procurement 60/40 Redwood/SkyScale. Shipping manifest template to use: webinar-swag-manifest-v1.xlsx (I'll upload).

maria (SkyScale): Rahul is confirmed for demo. Ops contact Lina will coordinate shipping labels once we send manifest. We'll also push the landing page copy from our side.

jamie (partnerships): One more note — can legal quick-check the demo script for any reseller/partner claims? Don't want accidental forward-looking statements. Tagging @legal in tomorrow's standup.

deploy-bot: calendar event created: "Redwood x SkyScale: Interop Webinar" Apr 28 11:00-12:10 PT — invites sent.

kevin (eng-runtime): I'll post the rehearsal runbook in this thread tomorrow. Outline will include: pre-checks, network test, fallback steps, who hits the mute/unmute, and a command list to trigger fallback.

jamie (partnerships): Thanks everyone — please add any blocking concerns. If no blockers by EOD Apr 12 we'll move to finalize assets and lock event. :tada:

lee (events): Noted. I'll block the rehearsal slots and share invites once speakers are final. :thumbsup:
